start_ray_cluster: start a Ray cluster with optional Slurm workers and Grafana monitoring enabled
stop_ray_cluster: stop the running Ray cluster and release all allocated resources
check_cluster_status: check the status of the Ray cluster including head node and Serve applications
deploy_applications: deploy applications like vLLM serving or LLM proxy to the Ray cluster
run_llm_inference: run batch LLM inference on input JSONL or Hugging Face datasets using a deployed app
